value.data: A luxurious, ready-to-move-in residential apartment project launched in 2012, featuring smart home automation and comprehensive amenities.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally express satisfaction with the well-designed apartments, comprehensive amenities, and strong security, along with the convenient location. However, some concerns are noted regarding maintenance, staff interactions, parking availability, and the overall expense of living.
